3250.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — How a Poisoned Security Scanner Became the Key to Backdooring LiteLLM
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("proxy_server.py", "sysmon.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/var/log/auth.log", "/etc/shadow", "/root/.config/sysmon/sysmon.py", "/tmp/pglog", "/tmp/.pg_state", "/dev/null", "/tmp/tpcp.tar.gz", "/tmp/session.key") or FileName in~ ("proxy_server.py", "sysmon.py"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3250.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — How a Poisoned Security Scanner Became the Key to Backdooring LiteLLM ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("proxy_server.py","sysmon.py"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/var/log/auth.log*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/etc/shadow*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/root/.config/sysmon/sysmon.py*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/pglog*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/.pg_state*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/dev/null*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/tpcp.tar.gz*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/session.key*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("proxy_server.py","sysmon.py"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

3294.def:
let LookbackHours = 24h;
let WindowMin = 120;
let BombingThreshold = 5;
// MFA-friction failure codes per Entra docs
let MfaFailCodes = dynamic([500121, 50074, 50076, 50097, 50158]);
let Bombed = AADSignInEventsBeta
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ErrorCode in (MfaFailCodes)
    | summarize FailCount = count(),
                FirstFail = min(Timestamp),
                LastFail  = max(Timestamp),
                SourceIPs = make_set(IPAddress, 25),
                SourceCountries = make_set(Country, 10)
                by AccountUpn, AccountObjectId
    | where FailCount >= BombingThreshold;
let MFAReg = CloudAppEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackHours)
    | where ApplicationId == 11161  // Office 365 / Azure AD audit feed
    | where ActionType has_any ("User registered security info",
                                "Admin registered security info",
                                "User registered all required security info",
                                "User started security info registration",
                                "Update user")
    | extend TargetUpn = tostring(parse_json(tostring(ActivityObjects))[0].name)
    | where isnotempty(TargetUpn)
    | project RegTime = Timestamp, TargetUpn, ActionType, RegIP = IPAddress,
              ActorDisplayName = AccountDisplayName;
Bombed
| join kind=inner MFAReg on $left.AccountUpn == $right.TargetUpn
| where RegTime between (LastFail .. LastFail + WindowMin * 1m)
| project AccountUpn, FailCount, FirstFail, LastFail, RegTime,
          MinutesAfterBombing = datetime_diff('minute', RegTime, LastFail),
          ActionType, RegIP, SourceIPs, SourceCountries
| order by RegTime desc

description: Detects HTTP requests exploiting CVE-2026-27118 — SvelteKit/Vercel cache deception via the __pathname query parameter combined with the /_app/immutable/ static-cache prefix that forces caching of authenticated responses.
references:
  - https://www.aikido.dev/blog/sveltespill-cache-deception-sveltekit-vercel
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2026-27118
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/20
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1190
  - attack.t1212
  - cve.2026.27118
logsource:
  category: webserver
detection:
  selection:
    cs-uri-stem|contains: '/_app/immutable/'
    cs-uri-query|contains: '__pathname='
  condition: selection
falsepositives:
  - Internal security testing or vulnerability scanners exercising the CVE
  - Bug-bounty researchers probing the app
level: high
3320.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Web.uri_query) as uri_query values(Web.uri_path) as uri_path values(Web.src) as src values(Web.user_agent) as user_agent values(Web.http_method) as method values(Web.status) as status from datamodel=Web where Web.url="*__pathname=*" Web.url="*/_app/immutable/*" by Web.dest | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)` | convert ctime(firstTime) ctime(lastTime)
3320.datadog: source:(nginx OR aws.cloudfront OR cloudflare OR vercel OR aws.alb) "__pathname=" "/_app/immutable/"

3321.def:
let LookbackDays = 7d;
let ExploitClicks = UrlClickEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Url has "__pathname=" and Url has "/_app/immutable/"
    | project Timestamp, AccountUpn, Url, ActionType, Workload, NetworkMessageId, IPAddress, IsClickedThrough, Source = "UrlClickEvents";
let ExploitInEmail = EmailUrlInfo
    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Url has "__pathname=" and Url has "/_app/immutable/"
    | join kind=leftouter (EmailEvents | project NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress, SenderFromAddress, Subject, DeliveryAction) on NetworkMessageId
    | project Timestamp, AccountUpn = RecipientEmailAddress, Url, ActionType = DeliveryAction, Workload = "Email", NetworkMessageId, IPAddress = "", IsClickedThrough = bool(null), Source = "EmailUrlInfo";
union ExploitClicks, ExploitInEmail
| order by Timestamp desc
3321.sent:
ImWebSession
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where Url has "__pathname=" and Url has "/_app/immutable/"
| project TimeGenerated, SrcIpAddr, SrcUsername, SrcHostname, DstHostname, HttpMethod, HttpStatusCode, Url, UserAgent = HttpRequestHeaderUserAgent, Referer = HttpRequestHeaderReferer
| order by TimeGenerated desc

title: npm Install from GitHub Fork Commit SHA (Clinejection Dangling-Commit Pattern)
id: 9b3c6a82-04df-4e15-83a6-2c7b58d91e6a
description: Hunts for the 'github:owner/repo#<sha>' npm/yarn/pnpm install reference. // Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("express.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FileName in~ ("express.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3328.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — npm backdoor lets hackers hijack gambling outcomes ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("express.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_name IN ("express.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where SenderMailFromDomain in~ (PhishDomains)
       or SenderFromDomain in~ (PhishDomains)
       or SenderMailFromAddress endswith "@npmjs.help"
       or SenderFromAddress endswith "@npmjs.help"
    | project Timestamp, NetworkMessageId, RecipientEmailAddress,
              SenderMailFromAddress, SenderFromAddress, Subject,
              DeliveryAction, DeliveryLocation, ThreatTypes, UrlCount;

    | where Timestamp > ago(LookbackDays)
    | where Url has "npmjs.help"
    | project Timestamp, NetworkMessageId, Url, UrlDomain;
MailHits

| project Timestamp, RecipientEmailAddress, SenderMailFromAddress,

id: a8c4d1e2-9b3a-4f5b-8c7d-1e2f3a4b5c6d
description: Detects the Scavenger malware loader chain delivered via the compromised npm 'is', eslint-config-prettier, eslint-plugin-prettier, synckit, @pkgr/core, napi-postinstall and got-fetch packages (CVE-2025-54313). The postinstall install.js invokes rundll32.exe against a node-gyp.dll dropped inside node_modules.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/another-npm-supply-chain-attack-the-is-package-compromise
  - https://invokere.com/posts/2025/07/scavenger-malware-distributed-via-eslint-config-prettier-npm-package-supply-chain-compromise/
  - https://socket.dev/blog/npm-is-package-hijacked-in-expanding-supply-chain-attack
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2025/07/22
tags:
  - attack.t1218.011
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.t1059.007
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_cmd:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'node-gyp.dll'
  selection_ctx:
    CommandLine|contains:
      - 'node_modules'
  condition: selection_img and selection_cmd and selection_ctx
falsepositives:
  - None expected; legitimate node-gyp is a JavaScript build tool and does not ship a DLL invoked via rundll32.
level: high
3340.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name=rundll32.exe AND Processes.process="*node-gyp.dll*" AND (Processes.process="*node_modules*" OR Processes.parent_process="*node_modules*" OR Processes.parent_process="*install.js*" OR Processes.parent_process_name IN (node.exe,npm.exe,npm-cli.js,yarn.exe,pnpm.exe)) by Processes.dest Processes.user Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.process_hash | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`

3341.def:
let _scavenger_c2 = dynamic(["firebase.su","dieorsuffer.com","smartscreen-api.com"]);
let _net = DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any (_scavenger_c2)
        or RemoteUrl endswith ".firebase.su"
        or RemoteUrl endswith ".dieorsuffer.com"
        or RemoteUrl endswith ".smartscreen-api.com"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessAccountName;
let _dns = DeviceEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where ActionType == "DnsQueryResponse"
    | extend Q = tostring(parse_json(AdditionalFields).QueryName)
    | where Q has_any (_scavenger_c2)
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, RemoteUrl = Q, RemoteIP="", RemotePort=int(null),
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFolderPath, InitiatingProcessAccountName;
union _net, _dns
| order by Timestamp desc
3341.sent:
let _scavenger_c2 = dynamic(["firebase.su","dieorsuffer.com","smartscreen-api.com"]);
let _dns = DnsEvents
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where Name has_any (_scavenger_c2)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer, ClientIP, Indicator = Name, Source = "DnsEvents";
let _proxy = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where DestinationHostName has_any (_scavenger_c2)
        or RequestURL has_any (_scavenger_c2)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer = SourceHostName, ClientIP = SourceIP,
              Indicator = coalesce(DestinationHostName, RequestURL), Source = "CommonSecurityLog";
let _asim = ImDnsActivity
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
    | where DnsQuery has_any (_scavenger_c2)
    | project TimeGenerated, Computer = DvcHostname, ClientIP = SrcIpAddr,
              Indicator = DnsQuery, Source = "ImDnsActivity";
union _dns, _proxy, _asim
| order by TimeGenerated desc

  curl of memdump.py from nikitastupin's gist into sudo python3, then filters Runner.Worker
  process-memory output through a unique grep for '"isSecret":true' and double-base64-encodes
  the result for emission to the GitHub Actions build log.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/harden-runner-detection-tj-actions-changed-files-action-is-compromised
  - https://nvd.nist.gov/vuln/detail/CVE-2025-30066

  selection_secret_grep:

    CommandLine|contains: 'base64 -w 0 | base64 -w 0'

falsepositives:

level: high

    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFolderPath, SHA256;
let SharedRegLoad =
    DeviceImageLoadEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "UevAppMonitor.exe"
    | where FileName =~ "SharedReg.dll"
    | where not(FolderPath startswith @"C:\Windows\WinSxS\")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, FolderPath, FileName, SHA256,
              InitiatingProcessFolderPath;
UevExec
| union SharedRegLoad
| order by Timestamp desc

id: 7b3f1e2a-5c8d-4a91-9f3e-1d2c8f4b6e0a
description: Detects node.exe / node spawning cmd.exe, powershell.exe, pwsh.exe, sh, bash, dash, or zsh. Production Next.js / React Server Components workloads should not require a child shell; this pattern is the highest-fidelity behavioural indicator of post-exploitation following CVE-2025-55182 (unauthenticated RCE in react-server-dom-* Flight deserialiser).
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/security-advisory-critical-rce-vulnerabilities-react-server-components/

detection:
  selection_parent:
    ParentImage|endswith:
      - '\node.exe'
      - '/node'
  selection_child:
    Image|endswith:
      - '\cmd.exe'
      - '\powershell.exe'
      - '\pwsh.exe'
      - '/sh'
      - '/bash'
      - '/dash'

3411.def:
// Defender XDR has limited HTTP-server-log telemetry; this pivots on outbound connections initiated by the Node.js process serving RSC after a burst of inbound 5xx (use UC2/UC3-network combo if HTTP logs unavailable).
DeviceNetworkEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(1d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node.exe","node")
| where RemoteIPType == "Public"
| where ActionType == "ConnectionSuccess"
| summarize ConnCount = count(), DistinctRemotes = dcount(RemoteIP), Remotes = make_set(RemoteIP, 20), SampleCmd = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine) by DeviceName, bin(Timestamp, 5m)
| where DistinctRemotes >= 3 or ConnCount > 20
| order by Timestamp desc
3411.sent:
let WindowMin = 5m;
let ErrorThreshold = 10;
union isfuzzy=true
    (AppServiceHTTPLogs
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
        | where CsMethod == "POST"
        | where (CsUriStem startswith "/_next/" or CsUriQuery has "_rsc=" or CsUriQuery has "RSC=1")
        | where ScStatus >= 500 and ScStatus < 600
        | extend SrcIP = CIp, Host = CsHost, Uri = CsUriStem, Status = ScStatus, Method = CsMethod, UA = UserAgent),
    (W3CIISLog
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
        | where csMethod == "POST"
        | where (csUriStem startswith "/_next/" or csUriQuery has "_rsc=" or csUriQuery has "RSC=1")
        | where scStatus >= 500 and scStatus < 600
        | extend SrcIP = cIP, Host = sComputerName, Uri = csUriStem, Status = scStatus, Method = csMethod, UA = csUserAgent),
    (CommonSecurityLog
        | where TimeGenerated > ago(1d)
        | where RequestMethod == "POST"
        | where (RequestURL contains "/_next/" or RequestURL contains "_rsc=" or RequestURL contains "RSC=1" or RequestContext has "Next-Action")
        | where toint(EventOutcome) >= 500 and toint(EventOutcome) < 600
        | extend SrcIP = SourceIP, Host = DestinationHostName, Uri = RequestURL, Status = toint(EventOutcome), Method = RequestMethod, UA = RequestClientApplication)
| summarize ErrorCount = count(), DistinctUris = dcount(Uri), SampleUris = make_set(Uri, 10), SampleUA = any(UA) by SrcIP, Host, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMin)
| where ErrorCount >= ErrorThreshold     // empirical — clean Next.js apps emit <2 5xx/5m per source IP
| order by ErrorCount desc

description: Detects DNS resolution of, or HTTP traffic to, giftshop.club — the hard-coded exfil sink in the malicious postmark-mcp npm MCP server (v1.0.16-1.0.18).
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/malicious-mcp-server-on-npm-postmark-mcp-harvests-emails/
author: Threat Atlas Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/22
tags:
  - attack.command_and_control
  - attack.t1071.001
  - attack.exfiltration
  - attack.t1567
logsource:
  category: dns
detection:
  selection:
    query|endswith: 'giftshop.club'
  condition: selection
level: high
3451.spl: | tstats summariesonly=true count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(DNS.src) as src values(DNS.answer) as resolved_ip from datamodel=Network_Resolution.DNS where DNS.query="*giftshop.club" OR DNS.query="giftshop.club" by DNS.query DNS.src | `drop_dm_object_name(DNS)` | append [| tstats summariesonly=true count from datamodel=Web.Web where Web.url="*giftshop.club*" by Web.src Web.url Web.http_user_agent | `drop_dm_object_name(Web)`]
3451.datadog: (source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.defender OR cisco.umbrella OR zscaler OR azure.firewall) AND (@DestinationHostname:*giftshop.club OR @dns.question.name:*giftshop.club OR @url.domain:*giftshop.club OR @http.url:*giftshop.club*))
3451.falcon:
#event_simpleName=DnsRequest DomainName=/giftshop\.club$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, DomainName], function=count())

  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, ActionType, FolderPath, FileName, SHA256, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessAccountName
),
( DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("npm.exe","npm.cmd","node.exe","yarn.cmd","yarn.exe","pnpm.exe","npx.cmd","npx.exe")
     or FileName in~ ("npm.exe","npm.cmd","yarn.cmd","pnpm.exe","npx.cmd","npx.exe")
  | where ProcessCommandLine has "postmark-mcp" or InitiatingProcessCommandLine has "postmark-mcp"
  | project Timestamp, DeviceName, DeviceId, AccountName, ProcessCommandLine, FolderPath, FileName, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFolderPath
)
| order by Timestamp desc
3452.sent:
union isfuzzy=true
( ImFileEvent

  | where TargetFilePath has "node_modules" and TargetFilePath has "postmark-mcp"
  | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, TargetFilePath, TargetFileName, TargetFileSHA256, EventVendor, EventProduct
),
( ImProcessCreate
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where ActingProcessName has_any ("npm","yarn","pnpm","npx","node")
     or ParentProcessName has_any ("npm","yarn","pnpm","npx")
  | where ActingProcessCommandLine has "postmark-mcp" or ParentProcessCommandLine has "postmark-mcp" or TargetProcessCommandLine has "postmark-mcp"
  | project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername, ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine
),
( SecurityEvent
  | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
  | where EventID == 4688
  | where NewProcessName has_any ("\\npm.exe","\\npm.cmd","\\node.exe","\\yarn.cmd","\\pnpm.exe","\\npx.exe")

3453.def:
// Article-specific bespoke detection — s1ngularity: Popular Nx Build System Package Compromised with Data-Stealing Malw
// Hunts the actual binaries / paths / commandline fragments named
// in the article instead of a generic technique-class template.
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where (FileName in~ ("telemetry.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName,
          FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
          InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc

// File-creation events for the named binaries / paths
DeviceFileEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(30d)
| where ActionType in ("FileCreated","FileModified")
| where (FolderPath has_any ("/tmp/inventory.txt", "/tmp/inventory.txt.bak", "/tmp/pr-message.txt", "/usr/bin/env") or FileName in~ ("telemetry.js"))
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath,
          FileName, ActionType, InitiatingProcessFileName,
          InitiatingProcessCommandLine
| order by Timestamp desc
3453.spl:
``` Article-specific bespoke detection — s1ngularity: Popular Nx Build System Package Compromised with Data-Stealing Malw ```
| tstats `summariesonly` count earliest(_time) AS firstTime latest(_time) AS lastTime
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes
    where (Processes.process_name IN ("telemetry.js"))
    by Processes.dest, Processes.user, Processes.process_name,
       Processes.process, Processes.parent_process_name, Processes.process_path
| `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)`
| `security_content_ctime(firstTime)`
| append [
| tstats `summariesonly` count
    from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem
    where Filesystem.action IN ("created","modified")
      AND (Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/inventory.txt*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/inventory.txt.bak*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/tmp/pr-message.txt*" OR Filesystem.file_path="*/usr/bin/env*" OR Filesystem.file_name IN ("telemetry.js"))
    by Filesystem.dest, Filesystem.user, Filesystem.process_name,
       Filesystem.file_path, Filesystem.file_name
| `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)`
]

3454.def:
// s1ngularity: AI CLI launched with safety-bypass flags as part of credential recon
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where FileName in~ ("claude","gemini","q")
   or FolderPath endswith "/claude" or FolderPath endswith "/gemini" or FolderPath endswith "/q"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("--dangerously-skip-permissions","--yolo","--trust-all-tools")
// the s1ngularity prompt writes to /tmp/inventory.txt — boosts confidence when present
| extend HasInventoryPrompt = ProcessCommandLine has "/tmp/inventory.txt" or ProcessCommandLine has "keystore" or ProcessCommandLine has "metamask"
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FileName, FolderPath,
          ProcessCommandLine,
          Parent = InitiatingProcessFileName,
          ParentCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          GrandParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
          HasInventoryPrompt, SHA256
| order by Timestamp desc
3454.sent:
// s1ngularity: AI CLI launched with safety-bypass flags — ASIM cross-vendor
ImProcessCreate
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where ActorUsername !endswith "$"
| where TargetProcessName in~ ("claude","gemini","q")
   or TargetProcessName endswith "/claude" or TargetProcessName endswith "/gemini" or TargetProcessName endswith "/q"
| where TargetProcessCommandLine has_any ("--dangerously-skip-permissions","--yolo","--trust-all-tools")
| extend HasInventoryPrompt = TargetProcessCommandLine has "/tmp/inventory.txt" or TargetProcessCommandLine has "keystore" or TargetProcessCommandLine has "metamask"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, ActorUsername,
          TargetProcessName, TargetProcessCommandLine,
          ParentProcessName, ParentProcessCommandLine, HasInventoryPrompt

3456.def:
// s1ngularity: node (post-install) modifies shell rc files — pair with shutdown content where available
let RcWritesByNode = DeviceFileEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where ActionType in ("FileModified","FileCreated")
    | where FileName in~ (".bashrc",".zshrc",".bash_profile",".profile")
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("node","nodejs")
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, FolderPath, FileName,
              NodeCmd = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
              NodeParent = InitiatingProcessParentFileName,
              User = InitiatingProcessAccountName;
// optional enrichment — a follow-on shell that actually attempts shutdown
let ShutdownFromShellRc = DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
    | where InitiatingProcessFileName in~ ("bash","zsh","sh","dash")
    | where FileName =~ "shutdown" or FileName =~ "sudo"
    | where ProcessCommandLine has_all ("shutdown","-h","0")
    | project ShutdownTime = Timestamp, DeviceName, ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName;
RcWritesByNode
| join kind=leftouter ShutdownFromShellRc on DeviceName
| order by Timestamp desc
3456.sent:

ImFileEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)
| where EventType in ("FileModified","FileCreated")
| where TargetFileName in~ (".bashrc",".zshrc",".bash_profile",".profile")
| where ActingProcessName in~ ("node","nodejs") or ActingProcessName endswith "/node"
| project TimeGenerated, DvcHostname, EventType, TargetFilePath, TargetFileName,
          ActingProcessName, ActingProcessCommandLine, ActorUsername
| join kind=leftouter (
    ImProcessCreate
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(30d)

3473.def:
// CI/CD Linux build host running Microsoft Defender daemon (wdavdaemon) or
// contacting MDE cloud endpoints. Real build runners should not be running
// EDR — presence is infrastructure drift (GitHub Aug-2025) or implant.
let CIDevices = DeviceInfo
    | where Timestamp > ago(1d)
    | where OSPlatform == "Linux"
    | where DeviceName matches regex @"(?i)(runner|ci|build|gha|github-actions)"
         or MachineGroup matches regex @"(?i)(runner|ci|build|github)"
    | summarize make_set(DeviceId);
union isfuzzy=true
(   DeviceProcessEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where DeviceId in (CIDevices)
    | where FileName =~ "wdavdaemon"
         or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "wdavdaemon"
         or FolderPath has @"/opt/microsoft/mdatp/"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, FileName, FolderPath, ProcessCommandLine,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, SHA256
),
(   DeviceNetworkEvents
    | where Timestamp > ago(7d)
    | where DeviceId in (CIDevices)
    | where RemoteUrl has_any ("x.cp.wd.microsoft.com",
                                "global.endpoint.security.microsoft.com",
                                "wdcp.microsoft.com",
                                "cdn.x.cp.wd.microsoft.com")
         or InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "wdavdaemon"
    | project Timestamp, DeviceName, RemoteUrl, RemoteIP, RemotePort,
              InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine
)
| order by Timestamp desc

title: GitHub Semantic Version Tag Deletion on Watched Action Repository
id: 9a1f3b2c-4e6d-4f1a-b8a2-7d9e3c1f5b88
description: Detects deletion of a semantic version tag (vX, vX.Y, vX.Y.Z) on critical GitHub Action repositories. Tag deletions are extremely rare in healthy release workflows and were the leading indicator of the tj-actions/changed-files (CVE-2025-30066) and reviewdog/action-setup compromises in March 2025, as well as the AWS configure-aws-credentials v4.3.0 incident on 4 Aug 2025.
references:
  - https://www.stepsecurity.io/blog/suspicious-tag-movement-in-aws-github-action
  - https://github.com/aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials/issues/1419
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2025/08/14
tags:
  - attack.initial_access
  - attack.t1195.002
  - attack.persistence
  - attack.t1554
logsource:
  product: github
  service: audit
detection:
  selection_action:
    action:
      - 'git.delete'
      - 'repo.ref.delete'
      - 'git.ref_delete'
  selection_ref:
    ref|re: '^refs/tags/v?\d+(\.\d+){0,2}$'
  selection_repo:
    repo:
      - 'aws-actions/configure-aws-credentials'
      - 'tj-actions/changed-files'
      - 'reviewdog/action-setup'
  condition: selection_action and selection_ref and selection_repo
falsepositives:
  - Maintainer-initiated hot-fix tag recreation (e.g. the AWS v4.3.0 Release-As re-publish) — must be reconciled against published release notes before closing
level: high

3495.sent:
// Hunt CVE-2025-29927 exploitation: external clients sending the bypass header to self-hosted Next.js apps.
// Header lives in WAF / reverse-proxy event text. AppServiceHTTPLogs does not surface arbitrary request
// headers, so we cover WAF (CommonSecurityLog) + raw nginx/IIS via Syslog/W3CIISLog where ingested.
let Window = 7d;
// Path 1 — WAF / reverse-proxy events that log full request headers/context
let WafHits = CommonSecurityLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
    | where (RequestContext has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (Message has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString1 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString2 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString3 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString4 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString5 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
         or (DeviceCustomString6 has "x-middleware-subrequest")
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP, SourceUserName, DeviceVendor, DeviceProduct,
              DestinationHostName, RequestURL, RequestMethod, RequestClientApplication,
              Evidence = coalesce(RequestContext, Message, DeviceCustomString1, DeviceCustomString2, DeviceCustomString3, DeviceCustomString4, DeviceCustomString5, DeviceCustomString6),
              Layer = "WAF";
// Path 2 — raw nginx / Apache access logs forwarded via Syslog (some teams strip headers, some don't)
let SyslogHits = Syslog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
    | where SyslogMessage has "x-middleware-subrequest"
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP = HostIP, SourceUserName = "", DeviceVendor = "linux", DeviceProduct = Facility,
              DestinationHostName = HostName, RequestURL = "", RequestMethod = "", RequestClientApplication = "",
              Evidence = SyslogMessage, Layer = "Syslog";
// Path 3 — IIS reverse-proxy in front of Next.js (header value sometimes ends up in csUriQuery via URL Rewrite Module)
let IISHits = W3CIISLog
    | where TimeGenerated > ago(Window)
    | where csUriQuery has "x-middleware-subrequest" or csReferer has "x-middleware-subrequest"
    | project TimeGenerated, SourceIP = cIP, SourceUserName = csUserName, DeviceVendor = "iis", DeviceProduct = "W3CIISLog",
              DestinationHostName = Computer, RequestURL = strcat(csUriStem, "?", csUriQuery), RequestMethod = csMethod,
              RequestClientApplication = csUserAgent,
              Evidence = strcat(csUriQuery, " | ", csReferer), Layer = "IIS";
union isfuzzy=true WafHits, SyslogHits, IISHits
| extend SourceIP = tostring(SourceIP)
| summarize Hits = count(), FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            SampleEvidence = any(Evidence), Hosts = make_set(DestinationHostName, 25),
            URLs = make_set(RequestURL, 25), UAs = make_set(RequestClientApplication, 10),
            Layers = make_set(Layer, 5)
    by SourceIP
| order by FirstSeen asc

// Memory dump primitive: python reading /proc/PID/mem (and usually /proc/PID/maps first)
let PythonProcs = DeviceProcessEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where FileName matches regex @"^python[23]?$"
  | where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("Runner.Worker","/proc/","memdump.py","isSecret")
  | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, AccountName, ProcessId=tostring(ProcessId), ProcessCommandLine, InitiatingProcessFileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
let MemReads = DeviceFileEvents
  | where Timestamp > ago(30d)
  | where FolderPath startswith "/proc/" and FileName in~ ("mem","maps")
  | where InitiatingProcessFileName matches regex @"^python[23]?$"
  | project Timestamp, DeviceId, DeviceName, FolderPath, FileName, InitiatingProcessId=tostring(InitiatingProcessId), InitiatingProcessCommandLine;
MemReads
| join kind=inner (PythonProcs) on DeviceId, $left.InitiatingProcessId == $right.ProcessId
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName, FolderPath, FileName, InitiatingProcessCommandLine, ParentCmd=InitiatingProcessCommandLine1
| order by Timestamp desc

description: Detects a python process reading /proc/<pid>/mem on a Linux host, the credential-access primitive used by memdump.py in the tj-actions/changed-files supply chain compromise.
references:
  - https://snyk.io/blog/reconstructing-tj-actions-changed-files-github-actions-compromise/
  - https://www.wiz.io/blog/github-action-tj-actions-changed-files-supply-chain-attack-cve-2025-30066
  - https://www.sysdig.com/blog/detecting-and-mitigating-the-tj-actions-changed-files-supply-chain-attack-cve-2025-30066
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2025/03/17
tags:
  - attack.t1003
  - attack.t1552.001
  - attack.credential_access
  - cve.2025.30066
logsource:
  category: file_access
  product: linux
detection:
  selection:
    Image|endswith:
      - '/python'
      - '/python2'
      - '/python3'
    TargetFilename|re: '^/proc/[0-9]+/(mem|maps)$'
  condition: selection
level: high
3499.spl: | tstats summariesonly=t count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime from datamodel=Endpoint.Filesystem where (Filesystem.file_path="/proc/*/mem" OR Filesystem.file_path="/proc/*/maps") AND Filesystem.process_name IN ("python","python3","python2") by Filesystem.dest Filesystem.user Filesystem.process_name Filesystem.file_path Filesystem.process | `drop_dm_object_name(Filesystem)` | stats values(file_path) as paths, values(process) as cmd, count by dest, user, process_name | where mvcount(paths) >= 2 OR mvfilter(match(cmd, "Runner\.Worker"))
3499.datadog: source:linux.auditd @auditd.type:(PATH OR SYSCALL) @file.path:/proc/*/mem @process.name:(python OR python2 OR python3) -@process.executable.path:(/usr/lib/snapd/* OR /usr/lib/python3/dist-packages/criu/* OR /usr/bin/gdb)
3499.falcon:
#event_simpleName=FileOpenInfo
| regex("^/proc/[0-9]+/(mem|maps)$", field=TargetFileName)
| ContextImageFileName=/\/python[23]?$/i
| join({#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 | regex("(Runner\\.Worker|memdump\\.py|isSecret)", field=CommandLine) | groupBy([aid], function=count())}, field=aid, include=[aid, ComputerName])
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, ContextImageFileName, TargetFileName], function=count())
